svg.text: TwoSkulls — draft v2: straight rails under removable ESP32
Planning drawing • component-side coordinates • physical fit still requires actual parts
Board seen through the ESP32; coloured wiring is on the underside.
Orange: separate ESP32 supply after diode
C1 / C2 bridge the rails below the module.
Arched crossings are insulated; no solder joint.
USB-C: opening up, cable enters vertically
Bracket height and flange hole centres: measure before building.
Capacitors sit beyond the ESP32 body, not squeezed underneath.
No new rail or wire beneath the antenna end.
Leave the centre programming-USB cable path open.
Side views are conceptual, not dimensioned fabrication drawings.
26 × 32 holes · 2.54 mm grid · socket spacing assumed 25.4 mm · verify body, plug, SD and bracket clearances
